## Summary

Sancho Godinho is a developer who builds web applications, developer tools, command-line tools, bots, and supporting infrastructure. His work spans software development, security research, open-source contributions, and DevOps. He applies security knowledge when building and deploying applications.

## Professional experience

### Dodo Payments — Community Manager & Open Source Software Developer

- Dates: October 2025 – October 2026 (part-time, remote; past role)
- Responsibilities and contributions:
  - Managed the Dodo Payments Discord community, including member engagement, technical support, and moderation.
  - Served as a core maintainer across multiple open-source projects.
  - Authored development of the Dodo Payments CLI.
  - Built and maintained the Dodo Payments Discord bot.
  - Developed the Dodo Payments migration tool.
  - Created and maintained the Dodo Payments sync engine.
  - Assisted developers with technical integrations.
  - Reviewed pull requests and helped maintain code quality, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
- Related public repositories:
  - https://github.com/dodopayments/dodopayments-cli
  - https://github.com/dodopayments/dodo-migrate
  - https://github.com/dodopayments/dodo-sync
  - https://github.com/dodopayments

### Open to work

- Dates: November 2026 – present
- Location: Mumbai (on-site) or remote
- Focus: software development, open-source projects, developer tooling, and technology-focused teams.
